Financial_Proposal_Complete.text: Financial Proposal
Executive Summary
- Purpose: Provide a comprehensive, transparent, and standards-aligned financial proposal for a mid-size enterprise technology implementation and managed support program over 3 years.

- Commercial model flexibility: We present three pricing options—Fixed-Price Implementation + Managed Support (Option A), Time & Materials with Not-To-Exceed (Option B), and Subscription/SaaS + Implementation Pack (Option C).
- Total estimated investment (Option A baseline):
- One-time implementation (incl. contingency): $1,440,000
- Recurring annual costs (years 1–3): $720,000 per year
- 3-year total cost of ownership (TCO): $3,600,000
- Benefit summary (Option A baseline assumptions):
- Annual recurring benefits at run-rate: $1,650,000
- 3-year cumulative benefits: $4,950,000
- ROI (3-year): 37.5% | NPV @10%: ~$0.125M | IRR: ~14.8% | Payback: ~2.7 years from project start
Commercial Assumptions and Standards
- Currency: USD; Taxes: Excluded and billed as applicable.
- Pricing validity: 120 days from proposal date.
- Invoicing: Net 30 days; electronic invoicing preferred. Late payments may accrue 1.0% per month.
- Escalation/indexation: Labor and managed services subject to annual CPI-U (US) adjustment, capped at 3% per annum.
- Travel & Expenses (T&E): Billed at cost, economy class unless otherwise approved; capped at 7% of labor unless otherwise stated; pre-approval required.
- Change control: Scope changes governed via written change orders; rates per rate card; schedule and cost impacts documented before approval.
- Compliance: Costing aligns with IFRS/GAAP revenue recognition principles for milestone and time-based billing. Audit rights and detailed cost backup (timesheets, receipts) provided upon request.
- Client dependencies: Timely access to SMEs, environments, data, and decision-makers; delays may affect schedule/cost.
Pricing Options Overview
Option A — Fixed-Price Implementation + Managed Support (Recommended)
- Best for well-defined scope and timeline with capped risk to client.
- Structure: Fixed fee for implementation phases; monthly fee for managed support and warranty.
- Benefits: Budget predictability; risk transfer to vendor; milestone-based billing.
Option B — Time & Materials (T&M) with Not-To-Exceed (NTE)
- Best for evolving scope with agile delivery; budget cap via NTE.
- Structure: Hourly billing by role against NTE ceiling; monthly true-up and burn reporting.
- Benefits: Flexibility; transparent effort-based billing; control via NTE.
Option C — Subscription/SaaS + Implementation Pack
- Best for clients preferring OPEX-centric model and scalable consumption.
- Structure: Annual subscription tiers with usage entitlements + fixed-fee implementation starter pack; optional uplift services at T&M.
- Benefits: Lower upfront cost; scalable; continuous value delivery.
Detailed Budget Breakdown (Option A Baseline)
A. Implementation Phases (6–7 months)
- Scope: Discovery, Design, Build/Configure, Data & Integration, Testing (SIT/UAT), Training & Change, Go-Live & Hypercare, PMO/Governance.
